//: Typechecks the test suite, which tsconfig.json deliberately excludes so `tsc` can emit from src alone. Without this, `npm run typecheck` covered ZERO test files — a fixture missing a newly-required ToolDeps field compiled only because nothing ever looked at it (APP-M07). Module resolution is 'bundler' here to match how vitest actually resolves the suite's extension-less imports; nothing is emitted, so rootDir and declaration are dropped.
